title: AzureLocal ZTP node list
description: Node list of the provisioning scripts. Example values only (198.51.100.x BMC addresses, 192.0.2.x management addresses).

name.description: Node host name = edge machine name.

service_tag.description: Serial number / Dell service tag the voucher is issued for.

management_ip.description: Optional management address (used by Start-ZtpMonitor.ps1 as the Sonar node address).

maintenance_address.description: Optional address of the maintenance environment (its provisioning-port DHCP lease, as its console shows it; reserve it). The Device stage reaches the Configurator App REST service there (TCP 20001) before the claim; without it the stage scans maintenance_scan_range (or the management subnet) and finds the node by its management MAC.

web_proxy.description: Optional proxy the Device stage sets in the maintenance environment (WebProxy: ConnectionUri, BypassList). Invoke-ZtpEnvironment.ps1 writes it from networking.outbound.proxy when scenario.outbound_path is proxy.

maintenance_scan_range.description: Optional start-end the Device stage scans for the maintenance environment on TCP 20001 when maintenance_address is not known (the provisioning DHCP pool, network_intents.management.provisioning_dhcp_range). Default: the management subnet.

bios.description: Optional BIOS attributes (Redfish Bios attribute name -> value) the Boot stage sets before the maintenance boot, for example { "Slot2": "Disabled" }. Invoke-ZtpEnvironment.ps1 writes hardware.bios merged with the node's own, with bios_during_provisioning merged over it.

bios_restore_fallback.description: Optional: for a derived attribute whose bios_restore value is empty (put back what Boot found), the exception: when the value Boot found equals when_found (the slot was left disabled by an earlier run), restore sets restore instead.

bios_reason.description: Optional: for the BIOS attributes ZTP derived from the inventory (a SAN adapter's slot, an embedded NIC), attribute -> why. Used in the message when the BMC's BIOS has no such attribute.

bios_restore.description: Optional BIOS attributes the Restore stage sets back after Network: attribute -> final value (hardware.bios), or an empty string for the value the BIOS had before Boot changed it (saved in the run state). Invoke-ZtpEnvironment.ps1 writes one entry per bios_during_provisioning key.
